text:
casey: quick sync - we're introducing a more expressive routing header for internal routing + quota hints. header name: `X-RI-Route-Broker` (json). want SDKs to support opt-in sending and graceful fallback to existing `Route-Hint`.

rachel: Can we make the SDK surface accept: string | dict/object? lots of apps still do single-string hints.

omar: yes. plan: public param `route_broker` accepts either. if string -> coerce to {\"route\": <string>} and send both headers while canary is active. we should also expose `enableRouteBroker` toggle (default false).

casey: telemetry ask: emit an event `sdk.route_broker.announced` when header is sent and `sdk.route_broker.coerced` if SDK had to wrap a string. console wants to show adoption rate + coercion rate.

rachel: also include `sdk_install_id` and `sdk_name` in the broker payload (opaque guid) so we can join traces. confirm no sensitive info.

omar: agreed, stable per-install id, not user data. server side will index it for dashboard correlation only.

sdk-ci: heads-up: adding header serialization tests + small e2e hitting `GET /v1/route-broker/debug` that echoes parsed payload. will run on sdk-ci.

devops-bot: schedule: route-broker service v0.1-canary -> infra-canary at 03:30 UTC tomorrow. canary parameters: 5% traffic, 14d window. auto-revert triggers: tenant quota mismatch > 4% OR 5xxs > 1.8x baseline during first 30m.

casey: semver plan: minor bumps only. py 1.8.2, go v0.12.2, ts 2.3.2. include examples + migration checklist in changelogs.

rachel: examples I'll add to docs. quick sketch:

```python
# python
client = Redwood(enable_route_broker=True)
client.generate(prompt, route_broker={\"route\":\"/dedicated/pool-42\",\"client_id\":\"inst_789\"})
```

```ts
// ts
const c = new Redwood({ enableRouteBroker: true });
await c.generate(prompt, { routeBroker: '/dedicated/pool-42' }); // coerced to object
```

```go
// go
c := redwood.NewClient(redwood.WithEnableRouteBroker(true))
c.Generate(ctx, prompt, redwood.RouteBroker{\"route\":\"/dedicated/pool-42\",\"client_id\":\"inst_789\"})
```

omar: SDKs should emit `sdk.route_broker.warn_parse` metric when coercion occurs so we can find apps relying on string-only format. Also log a single deprecation notice in the SDK log on first send.

casey: server-side will add a short-lived feature flag `force_broker_internal` to flip broker header for internal test orgs without SDK change. ops will use that for QA.

sdk-ci: i'll add unit tests, e2e and a quick lint rule to ensure header names preserved (case-insensitive) by SDK.

rachel: action items: rachel -> docs + examples, omar -> SDK PRs + tests, casey -> server feature flag + runbook, ops -> telemetry mapping + dashboard tile. devops-bot -> deploy.

omar: ack. i'll open PRs this afternoon and include the env var `REDWOOD_ENABLE_ROUTE_BROKER=true` for quick opt-in.

casey: thanks all. keep the SDK change minimal to avoid churn in client apps. :thumbsup: (end)
